about.description: KAIO provides tokenized access to private credit and structured finance products, connecting institutional lenders with decentralized liquidity. It enables securitization of off-chain credit through on-chain smart contracts.
about.registryInfo: KAIO (Hong Kong-based tokenization platform). Issues tokenized access tokens for institutional Asia-Pacific RWA funds — wraps subscription rights to off-chain Hamilton Lane / Securitize / similar feeder funds into on-chain transferable tokens.

fees.revenueNotes: KAIO earns platform fees on issuance + on-going servicing fees from the underlying fund managers it wraps (HKMA-regulated structures).
